description: Cockpit/nose section only of an RAF Canberra T.4 trainer, c/n 71427. Held in the hangared collection of the Flugplatzmuseum at the former RAF Gütersloh; the museum is not generally open and is visited by arrangement.
Ex-RAF Hawker Hunter T.7 two-seat trainer, c/n 41H-695450, held under restoration in the museum hangar at the former RAF Gütersloh.
Cockpit section only of Harrier GR.3 ZD670, c/n 712231. RAF Gütersloh was a Harrier station, which is why the type is represented here.
Second Harrier GR.3 airframe at the Flugplatzmuseum Gütersloh, c/n 712219, recorded in the collection as of 2022.
Ex-RAF BAC Jet Provost T.5, c/n EEP/JP/982, also carrying the ground-instructional number MG-78. Hangared at the Flugplatzmuseum Gütersloh.
aliases: Jet Provost T5; JetProvostT5; XW318; MG-78; MG78

description: Ex-RAF de Havilland Vampire T.11 in the Flugplatzmuseum Gütersloh collection.
Ex-Army Air Corps Westland Lynx AH.7, c/n 290, coded U; the Army Air Corps used Gütersloh after the RAF left.
Ex-NVA Su-22M4, East German tactical number 370, taken over by the Bundeswehr in 1990 as 25+06 and now in the Gütersloh collection.
Ex-Hungarian Air Force MiG-21MF carrying serial 9510, recorded in the Gütersloh collection as of 2022.
